bullets: The SDK now rewinds a stored run's message history to the point of an edited user message and rebuilds the run state so hosts stay in sync with the transcript shown during edits.
TikTok cost-per-activation campaigns now attribute Desktop and CLI runs to the surface's public product page instead of erroring, and conversion params gain a surface field of web, desktop or cli.

The off-peak price tooltip in the CLI model selector no longer notes that the first-tab discount is included in the displayed price, and the inline off-peak detail chip was removed from the selector rows.
GLM 5.3 Flash pricing ceiling stays at $0.14 per prompt and $0.45 per completion after a proposed raise was rejected on cost, with a second cheaper-inference lane carried as the capacity alternative.
